title: Field Guide
promise: Every handover, return and photo shoot, right on your phone.
lands_on: My jobs, today's jobs in order

sections.title: Start here
sections.blurb: Who this is for and your first sign-in.
sections.body_md:
### Who this guide is for

CarmaCars field staff: drivers, detailers, and drivers who also detail. You hand cars over, take them back, move them and shoot listing photos. Everything is on your phone. Your jobs are under **Field work** in the staff portal; if you also hold another function (Sales, for example), its pages are in the same menu.

### What you need

- Your phone, charged, with a data connection (photos and signatures save as you take them)
- The invitation email from CarmaCars (the link works for 24 hours)
- A car charger and a cloth for the camera lens

## Your first sign-in

1. Open the invitation email on your phone and press its link within 24 hours. Choose a password and press **Save the new password**.
2. You land on **Today**. Next time, sign in at `carmacars.ca/sign-in` with your Email and Password.
3. In your browser's menu, choose **Add to Home Screen**. The portal then opens full screen, like an app.
4. Open **Profile**, add your mobile number and press **Save my phone**.
5. At the top of the page, fill in your Home address and Postal code and press **Save my home address**. You need it before you add a rental or earn a commission.

![](/guides/img/field-04-profile-phone-f05000e2.jpg "phone; size: 390 920; pins: 4 92.3 78.3")

> Good to know: Recommended: on Profile, press **Set up two-step sign-in** and follow the steps with an authenticator app.

## Stuck on a page?

If you work on a page for a few minutes without anything saving, see the same error three times, or go back and forth between the same two steps, a small box asks **Need a hand with** the page. **Open the guide section** opens this guide at the right chapter in a sheet from the bottom of the screen; **Back to what I was doing** closes it and everything you typed is still there. **Open the Academy lesson** opens the lesson in a new tab. **Not now** quiets it on that page for a day. It never shows while a renter signs.

> Good to know: When we update our terms of use, our privacy policy or an agreement you signed with us, the next time you open your portal it shows **We've updated our terms**: a short summary of what changed and the new text. Tick that you read it and press **Accept** to continue. It does not change an agreement you already signed or a past booking.

sections.title: Today
sections.blurb: Your shift, then one list of the day: each car and time is one card. The Add button, and helping a renter on the spot.
sections.body_md:
The portal has four tabs at the bottom of the screen: **Today**, **My shifts**, **My pay** and **Training** (and **Sales** if you asked to do sales too). Today is where the work is.

## Your shift and the clock

1. At the top of **Today**: your shift, and **Clock in**. Press it when you start. The phone shares where you are at that moment only.
2. The bar shows how many of the day's must-dos are done.
3. When you finish, press **Clock out**. Anything still open is listed: give a reason for each, then press **Clock out with these reasons**. Fleet is told, so someone can cover them.

## One list, in order

The list is built for you from the bookings and the cars:

1. **Your work**: every pickup and return of the day (deliveries and collections too) at its time, and onboarding prep Fleet gave you. Each car and time is one card.
2. **When you have time**: cars to clean (not checked clean for a week), cars needing service or not roadworthy, and cars that need listing photos.
3. Switch to **Tomorrow** to see what is planned so far.

## A card

1. The time, what it is (Pickup, Return, Delivery to the renter), the car and its plate, the renter and the booking.
2. The steps of the card, ticked as they are done: the clean check, the add-ons in the car, the pickup photos and handover.
3. One big button: the next thing to do. **Start the pickup** or **Start the return** opens the job screen, where the clean check and the add-ons come first.
4. **More** has the place with **Open in maps**, the call to the renter, and helping the renter.

> Watch out: The pickup cannot be finished until every add-on (a child seat, for example) is ticked as in the car. If the trip must go without it, ask an Admin to override on the job.

## Clean checks

Every car is checked clean before each pickup and after each return: choose **Clean** or **Needs cleaning**, take the photo and press **Save the clean check**. On a cleaning card in spare time, press **Check it clean** the same way.

## Cars needing service, and listing photos

1. On a service card, press **Give an update** (taken in, at the shop, waiting for parts, sorted) and **Send the update to Fleet**.
2. On a photo card, press **Take the listing photos**: the photo shoot opens with the angles the listing is missing.

## Onboarding prep

Fleet gives you the prep of a car joining the fleet on a day you hold a shift. Press **Open the prep**, then each item: upload what it needs (the safety certificate with its date) and press **Mark it done**. When every item is done, the owner's onboarding checklist updates and Fleet is told.

## The Add button

The red **Add** button at the bottom right of Today:

1. **Money spent**: gas, a wash, parts, parking. The amount, the car, the booking and a photo of the receipt, then **Send to Finance**. Finance approves it and pays you back if you used your own money. No receipt yet: you get a To do until you add it.
2. **Service record**: what was done, where, the odometer, the cost and the invoice photo, then **Record the service**. The car's maintenance resets, the expense is made on the car, and Fleet and Finance are told.
3. **Photos of a car**: a photo and a note, saved on the car.
4. **A problem with a car**: damage, a warning light, a ticket or lost property (see Report, rentals, referrals and profile).

## Help a renter on the spot

From a card's **More**, or with **Find the booking** on Help a renter (by booking number, name or phone):

1. **Take a payment** or **Take the deposit hold**: **Show a QR for their phone** (they pay on their own phone), **Text the link**, **Email the link**, or **Use the card reader** when you have it. Never type a card number.
2. The licence: check it in person on the pickup.
3. The agreement: **They sign on my phone**, with their own finger.

> Good to know: Refunds stay with Finance and Admin.

## Check the renter's licence

The renter's licence photos and selfie are checked before the handover. You can check them yourself, for a booking on one of your own jobs today or in the next 7 days. Everything you do is recorded with your name and "field staff".

1. My jobs shows **Licences to check** when the licence front, back or selfie of a renter on one of your jobs waits for a decision. The same check is on the job itself, under **Check the licence**.
2. Press **Review the licence**. The images open with the name, date of birth and licence details on the booking.
3. Look at each image and the licence reader's lines under each driver (Pass or Flag: valid to the return, class, age, name and date of birth, the Ontario number, front and back): no sign of alteration, and the selfie matches the licence photo. A photo you take that is blurry or cut off says so at once: take it again.
4. One is wrong? Open **Reject this one** under it, type the reason the renter reads and press **Reject**. The renter is told why and sends a new one.
5. Then press **Approve all**: everything still waiting is approved at once.

> Tip: The renter's proof of coverage stays with the office. Meeting the renter at the handover? You can still check the original licence in person from the ready check (see A handover).

## Documents to sign

Your staff agreement, when CarmaCars sends it.

1. My jobs shows "You have a document to sign". Press **Read and sign**.
2. Check the key values at the top (your role, wage and start date), then press **Read the PDF** and read it.
3. Sign in a few steps: press **Send the code** and type the 6-digit code from your phone or email, tick that you read it, draw your initials beside the key terms (confidentiality, the rules on money, keys and cars, ending the agreement), tick the two consents and draw your signature.
4. Press **Sign**. The signed copy, with its certificate of completion, stays on the same page.

## Move a car

1. Under Moving a car, press **Start a move**. Choose the Car and Why (for example Reposition).
2. Fill in From and the Odometer (km), then press **Start the move now**.
3. When you arrive, press **End the move**, fill in Now at and the odometer, then press **End the move now**.

## Call and text the renter

**Call** on a card opens the Quo app with the renter's number, so the call comes from the CarmaCars number; **Text** opens a small window that sends from the CarmaCars number and keeps the text with the booking.

**Cars now** and **Map of your cars** are links at the bottom of Today.

sections.title: A handover
sections.blurb: The ready check, ID, card, odometer, photos, damage, signatures and the keys.
sections.body_md:
You give the renter the keys only after every check passes. The steps guide you one by one: press Next after each, Back to go back.

> Good to know: The job's header shows how much of the rental walkthrough the renter has read, for example "Renter's walkthrough: read 2 of 6 steps". Below 6, walk them through the rest at the car: what to bring, the walk-around, the road rules and the return.

> Watch out: Finish the handover in the app, to the last step. Until the pickup is recorded the renter's messages and the office's records are guesses: 30 minutes after the pickup time you get an alert and a text to record it, or to mark a no-show.

## Before you start: the ready check

The first step lists what must be done before the car can go: signed, paid, ID checked, deposit.

1. Each line should show a green tick: agreement signed, identity verified, coverage confirmed, additional drivers accepted, the booking holds the calendar, deposit taken.
2. A red line shows what you can do about it right under it (see the next part). Fix it, then press **Check again**.
3. All green? Press **Next**.
4. Coverage or the calendar not ready? Only the office fixes those: call CarmaCars. Still not ready? Press **Stop: do not release the car**.

![](/guides/img/field-21-handover-01-ready-phone-ecb54c56.jpg "phone; size: 390 410; pins: 1 91.0 63.4")

> Watch out: Never hand over keys if the ready check fails, the renter does not match the photo on file, or they do not have their original licence or the card on file. Stop and call us.

## Fix the ready check on the spot

Most red lines are fixed on your phone, without calling the office. Everything you do is recorded with your name.

1. Agreement not signed: press **Sign now on this device** and hand the phone to the renter. A copy signed on paper is not accepted.
2. Identity not verified: for each driver, press **Take** for the licence front, the back and the selfie. Hold the original licence: tick that the name matches, the photo is the person, it is valid past the return and it is class G2 or G. No expiry on file? Type the licence number and the expiry. Press **The licence checks out**.
3. Deposit not taken: press **Card hold: hand this phone to the renter**. They type their card in Stripe's secure form; take the phone back and press **Back to the job**.
4. Paid by e-Transfer instead: open **Paid by e-Transfer**, type the reference number from their confirmation and press **Record the e-Transfer**.
5. Paid in cash: open **Paid in cash**, count the amount in front of the renter and press **I received**. Keep the cash apart from your own money and hand it to CarmaCars within 1 business day, as Finance directs: Finance gets a task to collect it from you.
6. Additional driver not accepted: press **Sign now on this device (additional driver)**.

> Tip: An expired licence, a face that does not match or a renter who will not sign: do not fix it. Press Stop and call us.

## The steps, one by one

:::phones
1. Car ready: fuel full or charged 80%, clean, extras in. **Yes** or **No**, with a note for Fleet. ![](/guides/img/field-22-handover-02-car-ready-phone-c118e08b.jpg "phone; size: 390 350")
2. Is this the renter? Compare the person with the name and photo on file. ![](/guides/img/field-23-handover-03-renter-phone-813b8ced.jpg "phone; size: 390 350")
3. Original licence: name, photo and expiry match. A photo of a licence is not enough. ![](/guides/img/field-24-handover-04-licence-phone-80a47254.jpg "phone; size: 390 350")
4. Card on File: you have seen the physical card with the same last four digits, in the renter's name. ![](/guides/img/field-25-handover-05-card-phone-64652ced.jpg "phone; size: 390 350")
5. Odometer: type the reading in km. ![](/guides/img/field-26-handover-06-odometer-phone-34c4cbd7.jpg "phone; size: 390 350")
6. Fuel or charge: tap the level on the gauge, in eighths from E to F. ![](/guides/img/field-27-handover-07-fuel-phone-2df75f41.jpg "phone; size: 390 350")
:::

:::phones
7. Keys: how many keys and fobs you hand over. Use **+** and **−**. ![](/guides/img/field-28-handover-08-keys-phone-13bec781.jpg "phone; size: 390 350")
8. Photo set: 19 photos in order. Press **Take this photo** for the next one; every photo is also in the list below, with **Retake** if needed. ![](/guides/img/field-29-handover-09-photos-phone-767ecd4f.jpg "phone; size: 390 350")
9. Damage: tap the car diagram where it is, choose Where and Type, then **Add the damage**. ![](/guides/img/field-30-handover-10-damage-phone-a43b142f.jpg "phone; size: 390 350")
10. Tracker: it should say in place and reporting. **Check again** if not. The car has to go anyway? Open **The car has to go anyway?**, say why and press **Release without the tracker**: an Admin is told at once. ![](/guides/img/field-31-handover-11-tracker-phone-817976ce.jpg "phone; size: 390 350")
11. Renter reviews: the renter reads the summary of odometer, fuel, keys, photos and damage. ![](/guides/img/field-32-handover-12-summary-phone-b1787a2d.jpg "phone; size: 390 350")
12. Signatures: the renter signs, then you. **Use this signature** for each. ![](/guides/img/field-33-handover-13-signatures-phone-fac8ea8d.jpg "phone; size: 390 350")
:::

13. Press **Hand over the keys**. You see "Checked in. The rental has started." The renter gets the photo report by email and in their Documents.

> Tip: Photos wait on the phone without a connection and upload by themselves when it returns; the count shows what is still uploading. Each photo keeps its time, and the place when your phone allows location. No signal on a step? It says "Answers kept on this phone" and you can go on: press Try again, or they are sent when the signal returns.

## Sign now on this device

The renter (or an additional driver) has not signed the rental agreement yet? They sign on your phone.

1. On the job, press **Sign now on this device**. It shows who still has to sign and whether their licence is on file.
2. Check the person: the name matches their licence, and you saw the original licence. Tick both. No licence on file? Press **Photograph: Licence, front** (and the back and the selfie).
3. Press **Hand the device to** and their name. They read the agreements (CarmaCars' and Blind Spot's), tick the statements and sign with their name or their finger.
4. They hand the phone back: press **Back to the staff view**. The signature record says it was signed in person, collected by you, on your phone.

## The agreements at check-in

Both rental agreements follow the check-in.

1. Signing at pickup? Record the odometer and the fuel on the check-in first, then hand over the device: the agreement then shows the time, kilometres and fuel out, and the signed copy holds them.
2. The signer gets a code on their phone, initials the key terms, ticks the consents and draws their signature.
3. Already signed online? When you complete the check-in, the "as picked up" copy of both agreements is made with your readings and your countersignature, and emailed to the renter.
4. The check-in stops if the agreement is missing something a claim needs (a licence expiry, a VIN). Ask the office to fill it on the booking, or an Admin to override.

## The deposit on your phone

Deposit not taken yet? The ready check shows how to take it under the Deposit line. You never type a card number.

1. Press **Card hold: hand this phone to the renter**. They type their credit card in Stripe's secure form and press the button with the amount.
2. They see "Hold placed": take the phone back and press **Back to the job**. The ready check shows the deposit taken.
3. A rental longer than the hold limit shows **Save the card on this phone (long rental)** instead: Finance charges the deposit to that card.
4. No credit card? When CarmaCars allows it, the renter pays the deposit by e-Transfer or in cash: record it under the Deposit line.

## Add-ons to put in the car

A booking may come with add-ons: a baby seat, a child or booster seat, flowers, an umbrella, a phone charger or a prepaid full tank.

1. Open the job. Under Put in the car you see each add-on, how many, and what to do (for example "Put the bouquet on the front passenger seat").
2. Put every item in the car before the handover. The Car ready step lists them again.
3. Prepaid fuel: the renter may return the car at any fuel level. Do not charge for fuel at the return.
4. A chauffeur on the booking: Fleet tells you who drives and when.

> Tip: An item missing? Write it in the note for Fleet on the Car ready step and call the office before the handover.

> Tip: The photo count shows "19 of 19 photos taken · all uploaded" when the set is complete. The first photo must show the plate. Open circles on the damage diagram were recorded before; add only what is new.

## On one screen (release 28)

On the booking page the check-in is one screen: the time, km, fuel, and many photos picked at once from the camera roll, with the suggested angles as a checklist. If the renter checked in themselves, add your photos to theirs. The full checklist is still there when you want it.

## When a check stops the handover (release 33)
When something stops the pickup or the return (the deposit, a signature, the licence, the car's status) and the trip must go ahead, the job shows **What stops the pickup now** with each check. Press **Ask an Admin to override the pickup** (or the return), give the actual time, the km and fuel if you know them, and why. An Admin approves in one tap and the handover is recorded with the time you entered; add the photos and readings afterwards on the job, as with any handover recorded now.

sections.title: A return
sections.blurb: Odometer, fuel, keys, cleanliness, photos, new damage, belongings and signatures.
sections.body_md:
The return mirrors the handover. You record the car as it comes back and compare it with the pickup.

## Take the car back

1. Car and keys received: confirm you have the car and its keys.
2. Odometer, then Fuel or charge, as at pickup.
3. Keys and extras: count what came back.
4. Cleanliness: inside and out.
5. Photo set: the same shots, in the same order, as at pickup.
6. Compare with pickup: for new damage, tap the diagram, fill in Where and What it is, press **Add the damage** and take a close-up photo.
7. Belongings: check the seats, the trunk, the glovebox and the door pockets.
8. Renter reviews and signs. Then you sign.
9. Press **Complete the return**. The check-out time is the moment you press it: a late return, the kilometres over the allowance and the fuel or charge used are charged from it automatically. The deposit is not given back at the return: Finance settles it once tolls and tickets have had time to come in (about 7 days), and new damage you mark keeps it held.
10. The closing copy of both rental agreements follows by itself: time and date in, kilometres in, driven and charged, fuel in, the hours late, the new damage, the return charges and the totals, countersigned with your name, emailed to the renter.

> Watch out: New damage needs a close-up photo and a clear note. Finance uses your photos and notes to bill the renter, so take your time.

> Tip: If the renter already pressed I've returned the car, the booking shows **The renter says the car is back** with their photos and readings. Check the car in as usual: that completes the trip and settles their report.

## On one screen (release 28)

The check-out is one screen too: the actual return time (late charges follow it), km, fuel, photos and a note. A renter who returned the car themselves with km, fuel and photos has already completed the trip; add photos if anything is missing.

sections.title: Photo shoots
sections.blurb: Shoot a listing's photos in order and submit them.
sections.body_md:
A photo shoot job gets a car ready for its listing. You shoot the list of photos with your phone and submit them for review.

## Shoot the listing photos

1. Open the photo shoot job and read the tips: daylight, a plain background, the phone held landscape. Press **I have read this**.
2. The shot list: each photo with a short description. The bar shows how many required photos you have.
3. Press **Take photo** for each shot (or **From photos** to pick one you took). **Retake** to redo one.
4. An upload failed? Press **Send again**. Then press **Submit for listing**. You can submit before every angle is done: the missing ones are listed under the button and can be added later. Photos that fit no shot go in with **Extra outside photos** (any number, placed on the studio background like the others) or **Extra inside and detail photos** (any number).

![](/guides/img/field-06-photo-shoot-capture-phone-c0dae5b8.jpg "phone; size: 390 730; pins: 1 89.7 34.2, 2 89.7 67.8, 3 29.0 97.3")

The steps at the top say where the listing is: **1 Photos** (how many of the required photos are in), 2 Cover plates, 3 Review and 4 Live on the site. Wrong shot? Press **Remove** under that photo, then **Remove it**, and take the right one. A car with 2 seats or fewer needs no Rear seats photo.

> Tip: Keep other cars' plates out of the frame. The reviewer covers this car's plate before the listing goes live.

**Add photos** takes any number of photos at once from the camera roll, in any order: each is sorted to its shot by itself. Take at least 10, the whole car outside from every side, then the inside. A watermark or caption at the edge of a photo is cut off by itself; a photo with one in the middle is kept off the site, so take your own photos rather than saving a dealer's.

sections.title: My shifts and My pay
sections.blurb: Claim, give up and swap shifts, what you did on each, your hours, pay statements and pay details.
sections.body_md:
Jobs go only to people on a shift. Your hours are paid every two weeks at your hourly rate (CA$18.00 an hour unless your agreement says another rate), with the commissions an Admin has approved.

## My shifts

1. **Free to claim**: shifts someone gave up (first to claim takes it) and open shifts. Press **Claim this shift**. You can claim once you passed the academy.
2. **Coming up**: your shifts, each with the work planned so far. It updates as bookings come in.
3. Cannot work one? Press **Give this shift up** and say why. It is offered at once to everyone free then. Under 24 hours before the start it is marked late on your record.
4. **Swap with someone**: choose their shift and press **Ask for the swap**. They press **Accept the swap** or **Decline**.
5. **Past shifts**: each day with your hours, the jobs, the photos and the money you spent.
6. **Money you spent**: each one with where it stands. No receipt yet? Take the photo and press **Add the receipt**.

## Clock in and out

Clock in and out on **Today**, with your shift. Forgot to clock out, or a time is wrong? Tell Fleet: they fix it, say why, and the change is written in a log.

## Pay details

Before your first pay, **My pay** asks for your pay details: your full legal name, email, phone, SIN and a photo of a void cheque. Press **Save my pay details**. Your SIN is kept encrypted: only Finance and Admin can see it, every look is recorded, and you see only its last 3 digits. How you are paid (bank, e-Transfer) is just below.

## Your pay and your pay statements

A pay period is two weeks, Sunday to Saturday. An Admin runs the pay after it ends.

1. The pay is your hours times your hourly rate, plus the commissions and referral fees an Admin approved by the end of the period (see Commissions). Overtime and vacation pay are added only if CarmaCars has switched them on.
2. An Admin approves the pay run, pays you (by e-Transfer, bank transfer or cash) and records it. You get an email with the amount and how you were paid.
3. Under Pay statements on **My pay**, press **PDF** for the statement of a period: your hours day by day, the amounts, the commissions in it and how it was paid.

> Tip: A pay statement shows no income tax, CPP or EI. They are not worked out in the portal: for your tax slips, ask CarmaCars or your accountant.

## Where you clock in and out

The phone asks for your location once when you clock in and once when you clock out, and never in between. Allow it. If it is off, or you are more than 500 m from the lot, you can still clock in or out: write why in the box that appears, and Fleet sees it.

sections.title: Academy
sections.blurb: Your training: watch the lessons on your phone, pass each quiz.
sections.body_md:
Your training path is under **Me** > **Academy**: the handover, the return, cash and signing in the field, and the rules of the trip.

1. Open **Academy** and the first open section.
2. Press **Play** on each lesson: scenes with captions, read aloud by your phone's own voice. **Pause**, **Back**, **Next**, **Replay** and Speed work as on a video. No voice on your phone? The captions play by themselves.
3. Answer the quiz and press **Check my answers**. 80% passes and opens the next section; **Try again** as often as you need. Until you pass your path, the rest of the portal waits (the guide and your profile stay open).

> Tip: Nothing is downloaded: the lessons work on mobile data and use very little of it.

## Your first steps: Welcome (release 34)

Your first sign-in opens **Welcome**: welcome, then your profile and phone, then the academy, then your first tasks (press **Done** on each). Until you pass the academy, only Welcome, the academy, the guide and your profile open.

sections.title: Report, rentals, referrals and profile
sections.blurb: Report an incident, add a rental, commissions, your referral link and your profile.
sections.body_md:
Report anything that happens on the road, add a rental for a renter you found, share your referral link, and keep your details up to date.

## Report a problem

1. On Today, press **Add**, then **A problem with a car**, and choose the Car.
2. Choose What happened: **New damage found**, **Warning light**, **Collision while I was driving**, **Ticket or toll while I was driving**, **Lost property found** or **Something else**.
3. Write the Details: where, when and what you see.
4. Press **Take a photo** for each photo, then **Send the report**.

![](/guides/img/field-03-report-phone-3b903b20.jpg "phone; size: 390 1040; pins: 1 93.6 46.6, 2 93.6 64.9, 3 93.6 89.9")

> Watch out: In a collision, make sure everyone is safe and call 911 if anyone is hurt. Then call CarmaCars at 289-312-5991 before you send the report.

## Add a rental for a renter you found

Your home address must be in your profile first: until it is, the page asks for it.

1. On the Sales tab (or Profile), open **Add a rental**. Choose the car, the dates and the places, then type the renter's details. A renter already on file is found by their email. Car already out with the renter? Enter the pickup as when it left: it is recorded as on trip.
2. Press **Check the calendar and the price**. To charge another price, type it with the reason: a price far under the rate sheet is flagged for an Admin, not refused.
3. Choose **Send a payment link** or **Charge the saved card when the renter signs**. The renter pays online: you take no payment for it yourself.
4. Under Who found this client, choose **I sourced this client** or **Entered for CarmaCars**, then press **Add the rental**.

## Commissions

1. You earn 10% of the rental charge (before tax, after discounts, less refunds) of each rental you sourced: one you added and marked I sourced this client, or a booking made with your referral link.
2. It is earned when the rental is completed and paid in full, then an Admin approves it and it is paid on your pay date. Your home address must be in your profile: until it is, a commission waits as not earned yet.
3. **My sales** shows each commission: not earned yet, pending approval, approved, paid or reversed. A refund after payment comes off a later commission.

## Do sales too

On **Profile**, press **I want to do sales too**. The Sales path is added to Training; once you pass it, the **Sales** tab opens with the Sales pages. Your field work goes on as before.

## Referrals and profile

1. **Referrals**: your own referral link. Press **Copy the link**, or let someone scan its QR code. A booking made with it counts as a rental you sourced.
2. **Profile**: **Save my phone**, your home address (**Change my home address**), **Pay details** (how you are paid: only the last 4 digits of an account number are shown again), **Set up two-step sign-in**, **Change my email** (a link goes to the new address and the old one is told), **Change my password** and **Sign out**.

![](/guides/img/field-04-profile-phone-f05000e2.jpg "phone; size: 390 920; pins: 2 92.3 78.3")

## Sign in with your phone number

Quicker on a phone than a password: a 6-digit code by text.

1. On **Profile**, under Sign-in, press **Add and verify my phone number**, enter your mobile number and press **Text me a code**.
2. Type the code from the text (it usually fills itself in) and press **Verify**. Choose **My phone number (a code by text)** under Sign in with.
3. Next time, the sign-in page opens on your phone number: press **Text me a code** and enter the code. Two-step sign-in still asks for your authenticator code.

## Texts or email

On **Profile**, under **Messages**, choose **Email**, **Text** or **Both** for the messages we send you. Texts need the phone you verified above.

## Phone alerts

Get an alert the moment a job is assigned to you or changes, and when you are paid. Open **Profile**, press **Turn on alerts** under **Phone alerts** and allow notifications. On an iPhone, add CarmaCars to the Home Screen first (Safari, **Share**, **Add to Home Screen**) and turn alerts on from there.

## Alerts

The bell at the top opens **Alerts**: your jobs assigned, changed and running late, and urgent alerts passed to you. With phone alerts on (**Alerts** > **Settings**), they reach your phone too, and at 8 am a short brief of your jobs that day. A late job alert has **Mark picked up** (it opens the booking) and **Snooze 30 min**. Quiet hours (9 pm to 8 am unless you change them) hold the ones that are not urgent.

## Your name and password (release 34)
Open Profile. **Save my display name** changes how you are greeted, at once. Your legal name is the one on your signed agreements, so it is not edited freely: press **Request a name change**, write the full name and why, and an Admin approves it. Until then the name on file stays. To change your email, use Change my email under Sign-in; to add or change your phone, use the phone box under Sign-in (we text a code). **Change my password** sends you to the password page.

sections.title: Quick reference
sections.body_md:
### Where things are

| Item | What it is for |
| --- | --- |
| **My jobs** | Today and Tomorrow, in order; Vehicle moves |
| **A job** | Open in maps, Acknowledge, Start |
| **Report a problem** | Damage, warning light, collision, ticket, lost property |
| **My hours** | Clock in and out, your shifts, your pay statements |
| **Add a rental** | A renter you found: a payment link or the saved card |
| **My sales** | Your rentals and commissions |
| **Referrals** | Your link and QR code |
| **Profile** | Phone, home address, two-step sign-in, password, Sign out |

### Top tasks

1. *Start a job:* **Open the job**, **Acknowledge**, **Start**
2. *Hand over a car:* Every step, then **Hand over the keys**
3. *Fix a red line:* The buttons under the line, then **Check again**
4. *Stop a handover:* **Stop: do not release the car**, call us
5. *Take a car back:* Every step, then **Complete the return**
6. *Shoot listing photos:* **Take photo**, then **Submit for listing**
7. *Move a car:* **Start a move**, then **End the move** and **End the move now**
8. *Report an incident:* **My jobs**, the **Report a problem** button > **Send the report**
9. *Start and end work:* **My hours** > **Clock in**, then **Clock out**
10. *Add a rental:* **My jobs**, the **Add a rental** button, **I sourced this client**, **Add the rental**

### If something goes wrong

| What you see | What to do |
| --- | --- |
| **A link says it expired** | Links in our emails work for 24 hours, once. Press **Send me a new link** on that page. |
| **"Error 1102" on a page** | A short limit on our web host. Reload the page. You are still signed in. |
| **"That email and password do not match an account."** | Check the address, or use **Set a new password** on the sign-in page. |
| **A photo did not upload** | Check your signal, then press **Send again**. |
| **The renter does not match** | Do not hand over. Press Stop and call us. |
